notes: The picture is now measured by the frames it really shows on this phone, and a size that manages only a couple of frames a second is no longer left on the screen as if it were playing.
The upscaler is the first thing to come off when a picture is short of frames: it costs four draws of the whole stage for every frame, and a sharp size does not need it.
A size above FULL HD that cannot keep up lands on FULL HD in one move instead of running as a slideshow, and the size list marks the height that could not.
A size picked by hand is not taken away twice: pick it again and the tab leaves the picture where you put it.
The buffer kept in front of a sharp picture is capped in memory as well as in seconds, so a 4K copy no longer fills the phone with a buffer that is a reason for stuttering on its own.
